scenes.prompt: A tired but smiling French mother and father sit on a sofa in a cozy living room, looking at a big window streaked with heavy rain; two bored children aged 8 lie upside down on the armchair, a soggy umbrella dripping by the door, rain boots on the floor.

scenes.surtitre: AVEC LA PLUIE QUI NE S'ARRÊTE PAS…
scenes.prompt: Inside a cozy French home on a rainy afternoon: a slightly overwhelmed father holds a phone while three bored children aged 7 to 10 pull his sleeves, toys scattered on the floor, rain on the window, a cat asleep.

Three children aged 7 to 10 dressed as little knights with cardboard armor, golden paper crowns and a helmet with a red plume, kneeling on a living room rug around an old treasure map, one holding a big magnifying glass, rain softly falling outside the window.

Children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights search for clues inside a cozy house: one looks under the sofa cushions with a magnifying glass, another peeks behind a bookshelf, a third reads a rolled parchment clue, a parent smiles with a mug of tea.

Laughing children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet open a small wooden treasure chest glowing with golden light in a cozy living room, parents laughing on the sofa behind them, rainy window.

A kind old wise man with a long white beard and a burgundy cloak knights a proud child aged 8 wearing a paper crown and cardboard armor, with a wooden sword, in a cozy home decorated with garlands, other children knights cheering, treasure chest open with golden coins.
